name: static-page-conversion-contract
description: A safe local conversion preserves useful page content and removes known legacy presentation artifacts.
prompt: Convert a downloaded static ASPX file with a title, a spacer GIF, a one-cell layout table, a meaningful data table, and an obsolete WebResource script.
expected_behavior: Writes a separate HTML output and leaves the ASPX source intact.
Preserves the title, body text, and meaningful data table.
Removes the known WebResource script, spacer image, and one-cell layout table wrapper.
Does not connect to SharePoint or publish the result.

name: active-content-fails-closed
description: Common active HTML is rejected rather than copied into a page that may later be hosted.
prompt: Convert an ASPX source containing a script element, an event-handler attribute, or a JavaScript URL.
expected_behavior: Returns an error identifying unsupported active HTML.
Does not write an output file for the rejected source.
Does not suggest bypassing the rejection or claim that the converter is a comprehensive HTML sanitizer.

name: output-overwrite-is-explicit
description: An existing output is protected unless the caller explicitly passes -Overwrite.
prompt: Convert to a path that already contains a file.
expected_behavior: Rejects the existing output by default without changing its contents.
Replaces it only when -Overwrite is explicitly supplied.
Never permits the output path to resolve to the ASPX source itself.
